about.en: McDonald's xStock (MCDx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on McDonald's shares issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by MCD shares held with regulated custodians and tracks the share price on-chain; it is offered to non-US investors and carries a legal claim to the value of the underlying stock. It is the SPL token XsqE9cRRpzxcGKDXj1BJ7Xmg4GRhZoyY1KpmGSxAWT2 on Solana and the ERC-20 at 0x80a77a372c1e12accda84299492f404902e2da67 on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Arbitrum.
